title: Not a fan of the cute heart sponge, holder,  suctions pretty good, kind of cheesy.
text:
Not a fan of the cute heart sponge, holder, suctions pretty good, kind of cheesy.. The cute heart shape sponge was larger then I expected. On one side its a little rougher.
I use a natural sponge, and I’m not inpressed with this fake type of sponge.
When I run my dishwasher, I put my regular sponge in there, then the microwave for Two minutes
To sterilize it. Being this is sometype of plastic I think, it will not hold up well.

The sponge holder is much small then the usual one I use, and so far it suction to my large porcelain sink
Very good.
The holder is a thin plastic, not sure how long this is going to last for..its kind of cheesy.

product_metadata.title: Munchkin® Suds Up™ Cleaning Sponge and Suction Holder
features: Set includes: (1) heart-shaped cleaning sponge and (1) suction holder (refills sold separately)
Made of unique materials that clean effectively without scratching surfaces
Ergonomic shape is easy to grip
Suction holder provides quick, hygienic drying and easy storage
description: You probably don't love the amount of cleaning time it takes to wash all of your little one's bottles and dishware, but with Munchkin's Suds Up Cleaning Sponge and Suction Holder, we're hoping to add a little LOVE into the routine. A unique shape and pointed tip makes this sponge easy to hold and ideal for scrubbing in those tough-to-reach crevices. Plus, the easy suction holder adheres to your sink and allows for the sponge to stay cleaner and dry faster--preventing mildew buildup and smells. Munchkin's dish sponge is soft enough to not scratch any surfaces, but cleans like you need it to. Let's hear it for labors of love. Refill sponges sold separately.

details.Care instructions: Top rack dishwasher safe. To help reduce germ build-up sponges should be replaced every 15 - 30 days, or at first sign of wear.
